Quieter Sounds |sandbox = Yes |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|BossIcon.png|Boss}} }} ==Description== '''Boss''' enemies are major bosses which generally spawn at the final wave. In some cases, an enemy may be considered a '''Boss''' enemy only for its first appearance. This gives it multiple immunities or resistances to various forms of stalling, even if these immunities are not visible under their health bar. ==Mechanics== '''Boss''' enemies are immune to multiple effects, with varying degrees of resistance: #[[Freeze Immunity]], making it fully immune to freeze and less affected by chillness. #[[Stun Immunity]]; any period of slowdown is weaker on '''Boss''' enemies and prevents knockback. #Immunity to poison slowdown, namely from the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Biologist]] and [[Poison Ducky]], though it is still affected by poison damage or defense dropping. #Immunity from the confusion effect when afflicted from a tower, namely the [[Jester]]'s ''Confusion Bombs'' and the [[Biologist]]'s [[Nightshade (Unit)|Nightshade]]. #*The confusion effect from the [[Confusion Ducky]] can still affect '''Boss''' enemies. #Immunity to slowdown from the [[DJ Booth]]'s purple ''Drop the Beat'' ability. #Immunity to slowdown from the [[Harvester]]'s ''Thorns'' ability (and by extension any thorns generated by [[Farm]]s). #Immunity to a damage type, the [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. #*The explosion damage from the [[Nuke]] still affects '''Boss''' enemies. #'''Boss''' enemies cannot have their defense melted. #*Due to a bug, burn, freeze and poison defense melting sources work on it. #Immunity to being converted or slowed down by the [[Hacker]]. #Immunity to being slowed down by the [[Slime Trooper]]. '''Boss''' attribute also used to make enemies immune to these effects, but are not immune to them anymore: *When first added, '''Boss''' enemies were immune to being set on fire by the [[Pyromancer]], to prevent them from being slowed down. This was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], as the [[Pyromancer]] no longer slowed down enemies. *When first added, '''Boss''' made enemies immune to the frost mark effect. This was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], as frost mark was removed from freezing towers. *[[Stun Immunity]] was originally [[Energy Immunity]]. While '''Boss''' gives enemies some immunities, they are not always the same as the regular immunity. For example, the '''Boss''' [[Freeze Immunity]] only makes the enemies partially immune to chillness, unlike the regular [[Freeze Immunity]] which makes them completely immune to chillness. '''Boss''' enemies are also immune to some enemy abilities. For example, the [[Fallen Jester]] cannot apply [[Bloated]] or [[Nimble]] to them while the [[Slime]] cannot transform into them. '''Boss''' enemies take 1.4x more damage from bottom path [[Juggernaut|Juggernauts]] starting at level 4B, and 1.5x more damage from maxed-out bottom path [[Juggernaut|Juggernauts]]. '''Boss''' enemies have a purple health bar appear at the top of the screen. This health bar will display their name above it and will have various markers if the enemy has specific phases triggered upon losing a certain amount of health, though the markers are not always present for every enemy or in very rare cases, mark phases which do not exist. Most sounds, with some exceptions like game music will also get quieter. ==Enemy List== The following enemies are currently a '''Boss''' enemy, with the [[Freeze Immunity]], [[Stun Immunity]], poison
